title: Nameless Chart
summary: Start: enter Nameless Chart. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the ambush sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. The ambush holds until a keel crosses that line. The chart lies. False Rain moves. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside False Mark's shell. A drift rumor. The map is still wrong. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
